name: Reactions
summary: Reactions on posts, comments and messages
use_when: Readers should react to posts, tracks or artwork with one press, without writing a comment
Several kinds of content need the same row of reactions and counts
avoid_when: Readers should say something in words; use comments
The site has no accounts for its readers: a reaction needs a signed-in member

settings.description: The reactions offered, in the row's order: built-in keys only (fire, love, mind_blown), each once

env.name: REACTIONS_RATE_LIMIT
env.description: How many reactions a person may add or take back, as count/period; 60/1m by default

source.from: VybeMindz backend/app/routers/messages.py (add_reaction, remove_reaction, _build_reactions) and models/__init__.py (Reaction); icons from VM Website design/site/Post.dc.html
